fields.Name: T130 - Routines New Routine Editor
fields.Description: Opens the Routines New Routine editor once, then walks its bespoke composition UI (schedule frequency builder, required-field validation block, routine-type toggle, advanced-options disclosure, recipients add/reorder), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T322-T326.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in. In the Routines app (http://localhost:4200/app/routines), click 'New Routine' to open the editor and wait for it to render (10-30s possible). Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) schedule-frequency-builder - the editor has a Name field, an agent picker, a per-run message box, and a 'Frequency' segmented control (Hourly / Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Advanced); click 'Weekly' (or 'Daily') then 'Advanced' and confirm the schedule-detail inputs below change to match (day-of-week + time picker vs a raw cron-expression box) and a schedule preview line updates; (2) required-field-validation - WITHOUT filling in the Name and without selecting an agent, click the primary 'Create Routine' button and confirm the save is BLOCKED, a validation error area appears listing the missing requirements (e.g. 'Name is required.', select the agent), and the editor stays open; (3) routine-type-toggle - expand the 'Advanced options' section (collapsible toggle with a chevron), find the 'Routine type' segmented control ('Scheduled' / 'Monitoring'), click 'Monitoring' and confirm the help/hint text changes to describe monitoring behavior, then click 'Scheduled' and confirm it changes back; (4) advanced-options-disclosure - confirm the expanded Advanced options reveal a Description box, a Timezone combobox, an 'Active from'/'Active until' activation-window datetime pair, a Starting payload JSON code editor, and a Notifications section with a 'Notify me' dropdown plus In-app/Email switches, then collapse the section and confirm it collapses; (5) recipients-add-reorder - re-expand Advanced options, scroll to the Notifications 'Additional recipients' area, click 'Add recipient' to add a row (mode dropdown user vs external email, target field, channel dropdown, move-up/down buttons, remove trash button), click 'Add recipient' again for a second row, reorder them with the up/down arrows, and remove one with the trash button (do NOT save). Keep going until every section has been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: schedule-frequency-builder
checkpoints.instruction: switch the Frequency control and see the schedule-detail inputs change
visualCriteria: The New Routine editor shows a Name field, an agent picker, and a 'Frequency' segmented control; selecting different frequency options (e.g. Weekly, Advanced) changes the schedule-detail inputs shown below (day/time pickers vs a cron expression field) and a schedule preview line reflects the choice

checkpoints.name: required-field-validation
checkpoints.instruction: attempt Create Routine with empty name/agent and see the validation block
visualCriteria: Clicking 'Create Routine' with an empty Name and no agent selected does NOT create a routine or leave the editor; a validation error message is shown citing at least the missing name and/or missing agent, and the editor stays open

checkpoints.name: routine-type-toggle
checkpoints.instruction: toggle Scheduled vs Monitoring and see the help text update
visualCriteria: The Advanced options section reveals a 'Routine type' control with 'Scheduled' and 'Monitoring' options, and switching between them updates the descriptive help/hint text below the control

checkpoints.name: advanced-options-disclosure
checkpoints.instruction: expand the Advanced options section to reveal grouped fields, then collapse
visualCriteria: The Advanced options section expands to reveal a Timezone control, an 'Active from'/'Active until' activation-window datetime pair, a starting-payload editor, and a Notifications area with a notify-condition dropdown and In-app/Email switches, and it collapses again when toggled off

checkpoints.name: recipients-add-reorder
checkpoints.instruction: add, reorder, and remove notification recipient rows
visualCriteria: Clicking 'Add recipient' adds a recipient row with a mode selector, a target field, a channel selector, reorder arrows, and a remove button; a second recipient can be added and the rows can be reordered and/or one removed via the row controls
